stationScope.evidence: Official Stadtwerke Münster page states these prices for 'unseren Ladestationen'; do not attach to roaming partners listed on the same page.

specialParkingRule.note: Official page states the AC standing component at car parks and P+R locations starts after minute 480. No attempt is made here to infer which BNetzA rows qualify without a verified site classification.

roamingDeferred.reason: The official page explicitly states roaming users pay their eMSP tariff. Those prices must not be attached to the physical Stadtwerke Münster CPO.

note: Official prices valid from 2026-04-01. Ad-hoc credit-card tariff is 0.47 EUR/kWh AC and 0.52 EUR/kWh DC. Standing fee is 0.05 EUR/min after 240 minutes AC or 60 minutes DC, charged only 06:00-22:00; at parking garages and P+R locations the AC threshold is 480 minutes. The separate Momente Card tariff is not modeled in this file because eligibility/card-service conditions were not fully revalidated in this pass.
